# Project Phoenix v40.0 WP33: Phoenix Master Console (5-Tab Command Dock, Brebion & World Compass). Generated by gen_v310_wp33_phoenix_ui2_directives.py; edit the generator.
# Country-scoped O(1) scripted GUIs for Phoenix UI 2.0 Command Dock (all rebel & human guarded).

oe_wp33_dir_build = {
    scope = country
    is_shown = {
        is_ai = no
        is_rebel_country = no
    }
    is_valid = {
        is_ai = no
        is_rebel_country = no
        NOT = { var:oe_wp33_active_dir ?= 1 }
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_dir_cd }
    }
    effect = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_dir_cd value = 1 days = 14 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_war_override value = 0 }
        oe_wp33_apply_dir_build = yes
    }
}

oe_wp33_auto_directives = {
    scope = country
    is_shown = {
        is_ai = no
        is_rebel_country = no
    }
    is_valid = {
        is_ai = no
        is_rebel_country = no
    }
    effect = {
        oe_wp33_init_vars = yes
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_wp33_auto_directives ?= 1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_auto_directives value = 0 }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_auto_directives value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

oe_wp33_sgui_compass_colonial = {
    scope = country
    is_shown = {
        is_ai = no
        is_rebel_country = no
    }
    is_valid = {
        is_ai = no
        is_rebel_country = no
        oe_wp33_has_colonial_stake = yes
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_compass_colonial_cd }
    }
    effect = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_compass_colonial_cd value = 1 days = 180 }
        oe_wp33_init_vars = yes
        oe_wp33_bump_compass_audits = yes
        add_country_modifier = {
            modifier = oe_wp33_mod_compass_colonial_audit
            years = 1
            mode = replace
        }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wp33.201
    }
}
